rec.title: Record this session?
rec.subHtml: The recording stays encrypted with your key and is downloaded directly to your computer. Nothing goes to our server.
rec.lgpdTitle: Per LGPD (Art. 11 — Brazil's data protection law) and CFP/CFM:
rec.bullet1Html: You need the patient's express consent before starting the recording. Inform them verbally now.
rec.consentHtml: I confirm that I obtained the patient's verbal consent, explained the purpose, and take responsibility for safekeeping the recorded file.
rec.bullet2: The purpose must be explained (clinical record, supervision, etc.).
rec.bullet3: File retention is your responsibility — store securely for the period required by the professional council.
rec.bullet4: The patient has the right to request deletion at any time.
rec.stopConfirm: Stop recording and download the encrypted file?
